notes_for_editor: Single source: the Wikipedia Louisiana list, which gives the status 'Still standing/Inactive', the note 'Damaged', and the coordinates that match the record (30.665, -92.995). No build date, builder, design, staffing or access information was found. Two web searches returned only generic Dry Creek pages; the Beauregard tourism page and the Dry Creek community article did not mention the tower in the parts read. Guessed Fire Lookout and NHLR URLs returned 404. The Wikipedia reference for the 2015 item has no URL in the cache, so it is cited through the list. A parish or Louisiana Office of Forestry check would be the next step for build date and condition. Budget used: 2 websearch.py calls and 6 page reads.
